tool_schemas.description: Deploy a version of a service to all production regions.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: After the deploy of checkout-api v2.3.1 to production, the service failed health checks in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an error rate of about 18%. It was rolled back in all regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. v2.3.1-rc was not used because it was only healthy in staging. After the rollback, the service is healthy and the error rate is about 0.2%. Follow-up: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure before redeploying.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions and opened incident INC-0001 at SEV2. The service is healthy again.

- **Problem:** v2.3.1 was running in us-east, us-west and eu-west, was failing health checks, and had an error rate of about 18%.
- **Version chosen:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production. v2.3.1-rc is newer, but it was only ever healthy in staging, so I didn't use it.
- **Rollback:** All three regions are now on v2.3.0. The service reports healthy, and the error rate has dropped to about 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 describes the failure, the rollback and the results, and notes that the cause of the v2.3.1 failure should be found before it's redeployed. Opening it paged the on-call engineer. There were no existing incidents, so this isn't a duplicate.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0 (v2.3.1-rc was only healthy in staging).
